items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: dad was on the radio and he was on every week and was very well known and he would work with either Bob Hope before I was born, and then when I — after he was working with George Burns and Gracie Allen after I was born

ctx.x: Your father did a lot of announcing and being involved in some comedy shows. Do you recall as a kid hearing his voice on the television? You know doing a Maxwell House commercial or anything like that? What was that experience like?

Well it was actually radio until I was about 10. There really was no commercial TV per se and nobody had television sets, I mean there were very few. And dad was on the radio and he was on every week and was very well known and he would work with either Bob Hope before I was born, and then when I — after he was working with George Burns and Gracie Allen after I was born, and then he went back to work with Bob Hope, you know, when I was around 8 or 9. And I listened all the time. I loved both shows, and the way he…
You were only around 16 when he passed away, is that correct?
